svg.title: ALF-141 — Adversarial Harm Rating (AHR) Model: full data flow with numbered steps
svg.desc: Harm sub-type feeds a reference table lookup (step 1) producing a Victim Impact tier. Exposure indicators feed boundary bucketing (step 2) producing a Scale tier. These combine through the Harm Lookup Table (step 3) into a Harm Tier. Pressure data feeds an independent tier judgment (step 4) producing an External Pressure tier. Both are reported separately, with an optional composite score, as step 5.
